# ui-button

> Button component with press feedback and form association.

**Class:** `UIButton`

## Attributes

| Attribute | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `disabled` | `boolean` | Disables interaction |
| `type` | `string` | Form button type: "button" | "submit" | "reset" |

## Events

| Event | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `ui-press` | Fired on activation (click, Enter, Space) |

## Slots

| Slot |
|------|
| `label` |
| `leading` |
| `trailing` |

## CSS Tokens

Public `--ui-*` custom properties consumed by this component:

- `--ui-focus-ring`
- `--ui-font-weight-button`
- `--ui-line-height-control`

## Usage

```html

```
